title: Exchange at 5 s: native VCell vs co-sim
caption: As above, near the exchange steady state (A/B = 0.5).
simulations: One seed per solver and case, recorded every 0.25 s into results bundles (sims/render_3d.py): conversion to 2 s, exchange to 5 s. Native particles are placed at their nodes from VCell's per-node counts; its membrane is VCell's smooth surface.
interpretation: Native VCell holds fewer A + B molecules by now (its −6.8% exchange balance in the metrics: binning loss at exterior nodes, vcell-fvsolver#25); the co-sim conserves them.
